text.title: Unattended Automation Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: an Unattended Automation Record as YAML or JSON, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: What the automation would serve, in one line.
Every candidate trigger. Each item: `name`, `kind` (schedule|webhook|file-event|manual), `human_present` (bool), `when` (the time or event, concretely).
One trigger the current arrangement demonstrably failed to serve, with a four-digit year (r7).
The verdict. `none` is the expected outcome and installs nothing.
Whether any step must run a local binary. Decides the last surface outright (r3).
Which runtime: `n8n`, `make`, `dify`, `flowise`, or another named product.
Cloud instances of every tool assessed here cannot execute a local binary.
The capability agent hooks lack. Convenience does not qualify (r2).
The capability the OS scheduler lacks.
The machine that runs the trigger.

field.name: host_cost_per_month
field.required: when host is provisioned for this

contract.field: What an unattended run may write, publish, spend and hold credentials for (r5).
How a human halts it without reading the workflow.
Each item `{surface, reason}`. A second unattended surface belongs here, never alongside (r6).

section.title: Stop condition
section.statement: When every trigger has `human_present: true`, the record is COMPLETE at `chosen_surface: none` plus `system`, `triggers`, `failing_trigger` and `rejected_surfaces`. Every other field is omitted. A record that answers `none` and then specifies a host and a blast radius has not accepted its own verdict.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: If no trigger has `human_present: false`, `chosen_surface` must be `none` and no surface-specific field may be present. `needs_local_exec: true` forbids `make`, `dify` and `flowise` outright, and forbids `n8n` unless `self_hosted: true`. Escalating to `os-scheduler` requires `why_hooks_insufficient`; escalating to `workflow-runtime` requires both justifications. Any surface other than `none` requires `host_availability: always-on`, a `blast_radius` and a `stop_switch`. `failing_trigger` must contain a four-digit year. `rejected_surfaces` must be non-empty — including for `none`, where the rejected surface is whatever you were about to install.
